name: Your system
rules: Uses your screener: last night's setups (Momentum and Pullback) on the strongest sector, strongest stock list (your rule, from Oct 14): the stock is in your uptrend, its sector is turning up and rising (its breadth above its 10-day average), and it goes highest score first. The score is 40% the market (S&P 500 breadth), 40% the sector (its breadth) and 20% the stock (its relative strength rank inside its sector).

Holds 2 positions at a time, and never spends more than 30% of the account on one buy. Buys and sells at about 10:00 New York time, once the opening half hour's swings settle and option spreads narrow, then checks its exits every 30 minutes until the close.

Buys a call by your rules (15-30 days out, delta 0.50-0.80, open interest over 500, bid/ask spread under 12%), the one nearest 0.65 delta, on the first of the top 15 setups that has one within 30% of the account. If none does, it takes a cheaper call down to 0.15 delta (same days out, open interest and spread), the highest delta that fits, on the first setup that has one. If no call fits even that, it buys shares of the top setup.
Skips a setup that has dropped below its 50-day EMA by the time it buys.

Your overbought rule (from Oct 15): nothing is bought while the market's breadth or the stock's sector's is over the 75 line (the share of its stocks with the 10 EMA over the 20, last night). RSI and CCI no longer block a buy (you dropped that part of the rule on Oct 14).

Your exit (from Oct 14): it enters on the daily chart and sells on the 4-hour chart, once a 4-hour bar closes with the 10 EMA under the 20 EMA and the price under the 50 EMA, both at once. The bars are the Trend view's 4H bars (9:30 AM-1:30 PM and 1:30-4:00 PM New York) and only bars that close after the buy count. It sells at the next check after the bar closes; a 4:00 PM bar sells at about 10:00 the next morning.
Safety nets, my defaults: a call sells at -50% or 5 days before expiry, and shares sell on a 8% drop. No profit target: winners ride until the 4-hour exit.
fills: Paper trades, no real money. Shares fill at Yahoo's latest 1-minute price, 0.05% worse, and fractional shares are allowed. Calls fill at the ask to buy and the bid to sell, plus $0.65 per contract each way. Yahoo's option quotes can lag by up to 15 minutes. Dividends are ignored.

It's a Momentum setup (screener score 75.5): it closed above its 20-day high and is at its 52-week high, RSI 70, volume 0.9x its 20-day average. It's in your uptrend: EMA10 above EMA20, price above the 50-day EMA and the 150-day average. Why this call: delta 0.70, 15 days to expiry, open interest 587, IV 30%, bid $3.45 / ask $3.85. It's the nearest to 0.65 delta of the 3 calls that fit your rules and the $1,500.00 budget (30% of the account).
